description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified network domain
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-i7m2btk6g48 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNetworkDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to query.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to get this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to immediately recheck the status of the proxy server. Valid values:

true: Immediately rechecks the status of the proxy server and returns the latest ProxyState and ProxyStateErrorCode.

false: (Default) Returns the currently recorded status without rechecking the proxy server
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即重新检测代理服务器状态。取值：

true：立即重新检测代理服务器状态并返回最新的 ProxyState/ProxyStateErrorCode。

false：默认取值。不重新检测代理服务器状态，直接返回当前记录的状态
parameters.name: check_proxy_state

NetworkDomain.description_en: The details of the network domain

Comment.description_en: The comment for the network domain

Default.description_en:
Specifies whether the network domain is built-in. Valid values:

true: Yes

false: No
Default.description_zh:
是否为内置网络域。

true：是
false：否

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain

NetworkDomainName.description_en: The name of the network domain

NetworkDomainType.description_en:
The type of the network domain. Valid values:

Direct: direct connection

Proxy: proxy
NetworkDomainType.description_zh:
网络域类型。取值：
Direct：直连
Proxy：代理

Address.description_en: The address of the proxy server

HasPassword.description_en:
Specifies whether a password is set for the proxy server. Valid values:

true: A password is set.

false: No password is set
HasPassword.description_zh:
代理服务器是否设置密码。取值：
true：设置密码
false：未设置密码

NodeType.description_en:
The node type of the proxy server. Valid values:

Master: primary proxy server

Slave: secondary proxy server
NodeType.description_zh:
代理服务器节点。取值：

Master：主代理服务器
Slave：备代理服务器

Port.description_en: The port of the proxy server

ProxyState.description_en:
The status of the proxy server. Valid values:

Available: available

Unavailable: unavailable
ProxyState.description_zh:
代理服务器状态。
Available：可用
Unavailable：不可用

ProxyStateErrorCode.description_en:
The error code that is returned if the proxy server is unavailable. Valid values:

CHECK_PWD_FAILED: Incorrect password.

CHECK_PWD_TIMEOUT: Password verification timeout.

CHECK_PWD_NETWORK_ERR: Network error.

UNEXPECTED: Unknown error
ProxyStateErrorCode.description_zh:
代理服务器状态错误码。

CHECK_PWD_FAILED：密码错误，验密失败
CHECK_PWD_TIMEOUT：验密超时
CHECK_PWD_NETWORK_ERR：网络错误
UNEXPECTED：未知错误

ProxyType.description_en:
The proxy method. Valid values:

SSHProxy: SSH proxy

HTTPProxy: HTTP proxy

Socks5Proxy: SOCKS5 proxy
ProxyType.description_zh:
代理方式。取值：
SSHProxy：SSH代理
HTTPProxy：HTTP代理
Socks5Proxy：Socks代理

User.description_en: The username of the proxy server

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
